source_state: Uncommitted. Base plus source overlay; goal controller is an explicit headless experiment.

post_measurement_changes.description: Formatting/Clippy cleanup plus a speed-scaled stall threshold for low cruise speeds, covered by a new 0.1 units/second reverse-arrival case. The matrix uses cruise speed 2.5, whose threshold is unchanged. Six representative full reports reproduce exactly with the final binary.

notes: The five continuations share ScorchedState/native start within each setting; the goal branch constructs an explicitly new external TravelGoal controller.
Only the selected tank drive input differs in the goal continuation. Courses disable firing and park the other tank.
World and controller histories both participate in replay; source and native starting hashes are retained.
Different radii start from separately settled assemblies. Wheel mass, top speed, torque and brakes remain fixed in radius comparisons; rotational inertia and lever arms change.
All torque/radius experiments retain the production support gate. No physical default was changed.
All wheeled slope/rubble goal attempts exhaust two retries. Rigid tracks reach those goals; both gears refuse the trench.
Rubble mostly redeposits during the 120-tick settling prefix; these cases measure the resulting rough ground.

Native contacts expose false motor support refusals on 45-degree faces with chassis pitch near 20 degrees. This is evidence for the next support-classification comparison, not proof of a complete fix.
The 26 default-setting benchmark hashes are unchanged versus the prior CPU-ground receipt. Incidental timings in raw outputs are not performance evidence.
The local GUI remains the production driving behavior; --goal is headless and explicit.
